name: Service to the Horde
summary: In Orgrimmar, Zor Lonetree has received the jeweled pendant and has more to tell you about your service to the Horde.

sections.title: Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar
sections.body: The jeweled pendant now rests with Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar. Return to him to hear more about your service to the Horde.

sections.title: Zor's Last Word
sections.body: Zor says the scholars need time to study the pendant. He offers you a small token in recognition of your service to the Horde. Your deeds bring honor to you and to the Horde.

faq.answer: Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar has the pendant. You brought it there from Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
Report to Zor comes first. You brought the jeweled pendant to Zor Lonetree.
